cheeses.note: Only the cheeses named in each list's entries or name column; links to places, producers, dishes and other lists left out. A trailing "cheese" is dropped from the answer and kept as an alias.

apples.note: The cultivar name column of every table, the cider apples included; the a.k.a. names become aliases and "see" or "synonym of" rows are folded into the cultivar they point to.

cocktails.note: Only drinks: links to ingredients (bitters, grenadine, vermouth, sherry), tools and other lists left out.

coffee-drinks.note: Only drinks: brands, equipment, people, places and other lists left out; common café drinks the page does not name are added by hand.
